fixed.problem: C-45: with nothing fitting the budget, each left-out task had its own line saying the same thing. 'The tasks that run first take about Z' added up every runnable task, including tasks that run after the one left out.

fixed.how: session/start-check.ts gives each task left out for budget `aheadUsdMicro`, read in plan order (the cut is greedy). GET /projects/:id/start-check sends it as overBudget[].ahead, an optional field in StartCheckTaskView; the fake daemon does the same. BlockerLines uses it, and puts every task larger than the work budget in one line ('"A" (about CHF 8.00) and "B" (about CHF 9.60) each need more than this session's work budget of CHF 4.00 …').
fixed.check_in_the_app: Create three ready tasks: A (high priority, budget CHF 2.40), B (low, CHF 2.40) and C (low, CHF 0.80). Open Start with a budget of CHF 5.00 (work budget CHF 4.00). The line reads '"B" (about CHF 2.40) may be left for next time: the tasks that run first take about CHF 2.40 …'; before it said 3.20. Give two tasks budgets above CHF 4.00: one line names both.

The sentence reads 'Set the project budget for X from CHF 3 to no budget: only the monthly cap limits its spending.' and the read-back 'Remove the project budget for X? The fake daemon lists each project's budget row, as the daemon does.

not_done.problem: W14-9: show each session's CHF on the project's Sessions tab (/projects/:id/sessions).
not_done.why: The project has no Sessions tab. PROJECT_TABS (ProjectPage.tsx) lists Overview, Tasks, Chat, Files, Plan, Docs, Reviews, Costs and Data, and /projects/:id/sessions redirects to the Overview. The fixup's own screenshot of that 'tab' (/tmp/frbench/fixup-leftovers7-session/steps/06-after-sessions-tab-after-crash.png) is the Overview, and so is mine (14-after-sessions-tab.png). A list of a project's sessions would be a new screen, which design §6 does not have. The one session a project shows (Last result) carries its CHF in the session's result sentence ('… CHF 0.80.'), and its page shows the spend. Left for the owner or the session lead to decide whether a sessions list is wanted.

not_done.problem: Fast mode's row and card quote the price table in USD ('USD 8 / 40 per million …'). The acceptance asks for no 'USD' anywhere in Settings.
not_done.why: Those words are fastModeDescription and the fast_mode effect, which quote the provider's price table. Turning them into CHF changes a pricing statement that commands/fast-mode tests and ADR 0057 assert, and that is not one of this area's items. The real-daemon case excludes that row and says so. The calibration and handover, which are this area's, are now in CHF.

not_done.problem: Existing installs keep reading CHF 150.40 for the default cap.
not_done.why: Only a fresh install's first human now gets the CHF figure (compose.ts insert). An install created earlier has USD 188 with no CHF figure, so settings-view's capMoney converts at the day's rate, as before. Correcting stored rows would be a migration, which is outside this area. Saving any cap in Settings stores the CHF figure.

not_done.problem: Owner questions: the monthly cap and 0; the meaning of the Files line's time.
not_done.why: Not decided. The monthly cap's 0 is built as recommended meanwhile: refused, with why, and a project's and a task's budget take 0 (see notes). FilesTab is unchanged because the owner has not answered; its time was already 24-hour.
